description: Each service is structured around a single business outcome - so scope, investment, and next steps all point in the same direction.

index.title: Start from the problem you need solved —

audit.outcome: Prioritized findings and an execution-ready roadmap in 5 business days.
audit.problem: Need clarity before a costly decision?
deliverables: Risk-ranked findings across architecture, performance and SEO
A recommended rebuild-or-repair path, with its trade-offs
A roadmap any team can execute — ours or yours
audit.leaves: A decision you can defend, in five days.

maintenance.outcome: Predictable coverage without firefighting — releases, monitoring, and one accountable partner.
deliverables: Monitoring, patching and backups on a defined cycle
Content and small feature updates without a new project
A direct channel to engineers who know the codebase
maintenance.leaves: A system that keeps working after we leave.

portal.outcome: A system that removes operational bottlenecks, supports scale, and fits how the business actually works.
portal.problem: Need custom workflows or product logic?
deliverables: Dashboards and workflows modelled on how your team actually operates
A typed, documented codebase on a stack you own
An automated build-and-deploy pipeline from the first release

website.outcome: A custom multilingual website with strong performance, clear messaging, and a conversion-ready structure.
deliverables: A custom site with English and Arabic engineered as equals
Page structures designed around one conversion path
Performance measured against Core Web Vitals before launch
website.leaves: A site that is yours, not rented.

title: Four focused disciplines.

items: Scope and price written down before work begins.
Built from your requirements — never a recycled theme.
Arabic and English engineered as equals.
Code, accounts and findings stay in your name.

stage.label: What we do, and how it runs

loop.title: Ideas enter.
loop.description: An idea rarely arrives finished. It moves — out of ambiguity into structure, out of structure into something that runs, and out of that into the next question.
loop.insideBuild: Inside every build — not sold separately.

close.statement: Every system you own asks the next question. Bring us the one you are holding now.
close.title: Every system you own
close.body: Bring us the one you are holding now.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: Before anything is built, we establish what is actually worth building — and what it costs to get wrong.
discover.hands: A risk-ranked roadmap. It becomes the architecture's brief.

architect.title: Architect
architect.body: Strategy becomes a sitemap, a data model and an interface designed to scale — decided on paper, where changing it is still cheap.
architect.hands: An approved structure. It becomes the build's scope.

build.title: Build
build.statement: We turn the structure into a product.
build.body: Design and engineering converge into one working system — custom code, not a template in a new skin.
build.hands: Documented code in your repository. It becomes the launch candidate.

launch.title: Launch
launch.statement: We put it into the world.
launch.body: The system ships to accounts in your name, meets real traffic and starts returning signals.
launch.hands: A live system and its monitoring. They become the support runbook.

evolve.title: Evolve
evolve.statement: The work does not end at launch.
evolve.body: We refine, extend and harden the system as the business changes — releases, monitoring, one accountable partner.
evolve.hands: What monitoring surfaces. It becomes the next Discover's starting point.
